violated_contract: An implicit default or fill-if-missing setting must never overwrite an explicit user choice committed since the writer read the document. Timezone and token registration must preserve a concurrent daily-summary opt-out and chosen hour; desktop-only timezone seeding must retain a client-reported zone.
canonical_prevention: All related settings writers use one transactional default-materialization primitive. Compute defaults and the fill-if-missing predicate from the transactional snapshot, then atomically update only that patch or create the missing document. Explicit request fields remain authoritative. Restart only explicit transaction contention on a fresh transaction using the shared bounded retry helper.
